heading: K League All-Stars vs Manchester City LIVE streaming info: Where to watch pre-season friendly match?
author: Sportstar News Desk
paragraphs: Updated : Aug 08, 2026 00:32 IST , Chennai - 1 MIN READ
Manchester City will begin its Premier League 2026-27 season against Bournemouth on August 23. | Photo Credit: AP
Manchester City will continue its pre-season training when it takes on K League All-Stars at the Seoul World Cup Stadium in South Korea on Wednesday.

Enzo Maresca, who replaced Pep Guardiola over the summer, took charge of City for the first time during the side’s first match of pre-season against Inter Milan, which it lost on penalties after the game ended 1-1.
City will finish off its friendlies against Atletico Madrid on August 9 before taking on Arsenal in the Community Shield match on August 16.
When will the K League All-Stars vs Manchester City match kick off?
The match is scheduled to kick-off at 4:30 p.m. IST.
Where to watch the K League All-Stars vs Manchester City match?
The match will not be telecast or live-streamed anywhere in India. The match can be viewed globally on Manchester City’s official streaming service, CITY+.
